rows.ARS:
Medium red Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Red Ayoba
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 2001).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2010 as 'Red Ayoba'.
Introduced in United States by Newflora™ LLC in 2014 as 'Kardinal Kolorscape'.
rows.Bloom: Red. None / no fragrance. 16 to 20 petals. Average diameter 2.75". Medium, semi-double to double, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Small, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Glossy, medium green, leathery foliage. 7 leaflets.

Height: up to 35" (up to 90cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
